title: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) Level Variations in Early Pregnancy
brief_summary: Retrospective comparative study comparing group 1 (TSH level 0.1-1.99 mIU/L) and group 2 (TSH level 2.0-4 mIU/L). Each group was further subdivided into primigravidae and multipara. 1527 pregnant women were included.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnant women
2. Previously healthy

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. known thyroid diseases
study_population: pregnant unknown to have thyroid disease
